sql: SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, name_norm, uei, registrant_cik, status FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor WHERE status = 'active' AND upper(legal_name) LIKE concat('%', 'BOOZ', '%') LIMIT 20

SELECT invoice_no, vendor_id, amount_usd, CAST(invoice_date AS STRING) AS invoice_date, status FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.ap_invoice WHERE invoice_no IN ('INV-BAH-20931', 'INV-BAH-20944', 'INV-BAH-20967') LIMIT 20
SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, email_domains_on_file FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor WHERE array_contains(split(email_domains_on_file, ','), 'boozallen-payments.example') LIMIT 10
SELECT 'registrant' AS via, cik AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON INC' LIMIT 50
SELECT 'entity' AS via, entity_key AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON INC' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'alias' AS via, entity_or_cik AS key, alias_name AS name, alias_name_norm AS name_norm, alias_source FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_alias WHERE alias_name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON INC' LIMIT 50

SELECT item_id, vendor_id, vendor_name, invoice_no, amount_usd, CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS scheduled_date, cutoff_local, SUM(amount_usd) OVER () AS run_amount_usd, COUNT(*) OVER () AS run_item_count FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item WHERE payment_run_id = 'PR-2026-10-30' LIMIT 500

SELECT contact_id, kind, value, CAST(valid_from AS STRING) AS valid_from, CAST(valid_to AS STRING) AS valid_to, changed_via FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_contact WHERE vendor_id = 'V-10027' ORDER BY valid_from LIMIT 50

SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, name_norm, uei, registrant_cik, remit_line1, remit_unit, remit_city, remit_state, remit_zip, status, CAST(created_at AS STRING) AS created_at, email_domains_on_file FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor WHERE vendor_id = 'V-10027' LIMIT 1

SELECT log_id, vendor_id, request_id, purpose, phone_e164, phone_source, outcome, CAST(called_at AS STRING) AS called_at, called_by FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_contact_log WHERE request_id = 'BCR-2026-0412' OR vendor_id = 'V-10027' ORDER BY called_at LIMIT 50

SELECT via, owner_vendor_id, request_id, bank_account_id, status, at_ts, vendor_name FROM (
  SELECT 'vendor_bank_account' AS via, b.vendor_id AS owner_vendor_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS request_id,
         b.bank_account_id AS bank_account_id, b.status AS status, CAST(b.changed_at AS STRING) AS at_ts, v.legal_name AS vendor_name
  FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b
  JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = b.vendor_id
  WHERE b.account_hash = '175dbd7da76270843def1d6ba77e9bf08cc9f0bcac9a452456da437e4893abe6'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'bank_change_request', r.vendor_id, r.request_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING), r.status, CAST(r.received_at AS STRING), CAST(NULL AS STRING)
  FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.bank_change_request r
  WHERE r.new_account_hash = '175dbd7da76270843def1d6ba77e9bf08cc9f0bcac9a452456da437e4893abe6'
) x
LIMIT 50

SELECT v.vendor_id, v.legal_name AS vm_name, v.uei, v.registrant_cik, v.remit_line1, v.remit_city, v.remit_state,
       v.email_domains_on_file, e.entity_key, e.legal_name AS usa_name, e.parent_uei, e.address_line1 AS usa_line1,
       e.city_name AS usa_city, e.state_code AS usa_state, s.cik, s.legal_name AS sec_name, s.phone AS sec_phone,
       s.ein AS sec_ein, s.biz_street1, s.biz_city, s.biz_state
FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity e ON e.uei = v.uei
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant s ON s.cik = v.registrant_cik
WHERE v.vendor_id = 'V-10027'
LIMIT 10

SELECT entity_key AS p_entity_key, legal_name AS p_legal_name, address_line1 AS p_address_line1, city_name AS p_city_name,
       state_code AS p_state_code, zip AS p_zip
FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity
WHERE uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65' AND recipient_level = 'P'
LIMIT 1

SELECT 'registrant' AS via, cik AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORP' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'entity' AS via, entity_key AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORP' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'alias' AS via, entity_or_cik AS key, alias_name AS name, alias_name_norm AS name_norm, alias_source FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_alias WHERE alias_name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORP' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'registrant' AS via, cik AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORPORATION' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'entity' AS via, entity_key AS key, legal_name AS name, name_norm AS name_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity WHERE name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORPORATION' LIMIT 50

SELECT 'alias' AS via, entity_or_cik AS key, alias_name AS name, alias_name_norm AS name_norm, alias_source FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_alias WHERE alias_name_norm = 'BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON HOLDING CORPORATION' LIMIT 50

SELECT child_uei, child_recipient_id, child_name, state_province, amount, list_size FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_child WHERE parent_uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65' AND state_province = 'NJ' ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 250

-- t11_split
SELECT f.entity_key AS row_key, f.uei AS matched_uei, f.recipient_level AS matched_level, f.legal_name AS matched_name, f.address_line1, f.city_name, f.state_code, f.zip, 'usl' AS via, v.vendor_id AS vendor_id_on_file FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity f LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.uei = f.uei WHERE (f.parent_uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65' OR f.uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65') AND f.state_code = 'NJ' AND upper(f.city_name) = 'TINTON FALLS' AND f.address_line1 LIKE '1 %' LIMIT 50
-- next
SELECT concat(CAST(uei AS STRING), '-', CAST(recipient_level AS STRING)) AS row_key, CAST(uei AS STRING) AS matched_uei, CAST(recipient_level AS STRING) AS matched_level, CAST(name AS STRING) AS matched_name, CAST(location.address_line1 AS STRING) AS address_line1, CAST(location.city_name AS STRING) AS city_name, CAST(location.state_code AS STRING) AS state_code, CAST(location.zip AS STRING) AS zip, 'session.pp_usa_r_khk6e1jw9c15' AS via FROM session.pp_usa_r_khk6e1jw9c15 WHERE CAST(location.state_code AS STRING) = 'NJ' AND upper(CAST(location.city_name AS STRING)) = 'TINTON FALLS' AND CAST(location.address_line1 AS STRING) LIKE '1 %' LIMIT 50

-- t11_split
SELECT f.entity_key AS row_key, f.uei AS matched_uei, f.recipient_level AS matched_level, f.legal_name AS matched_name, f.address_line1, f.city_name, f.state_code, f.zip, 'usl' AS via, v.vendor_id AS vendor_id_on_file FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity f LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.uei = f.uei WHERE (f.parent_uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65' OR f.uei = 'MBPHTU7Y9S65') AND f.state_code = 'NJ' AND upper(f.city_name) = 'TINTON FALLS' AND f.address_line1 LIKE '1 %' LIMIT 50
-- next
SELECT concat(CAST(uei AS STRING), '-', CAST(recipient_level AS STRING)) AS row_key, CAST(uei AS STRING) AS matched_uei, CAST(recipient_level AS STRING) AS matched_level, CAST(name AS STRING) AS matched_name, CAST(location.address_line1 AS STRING) AS address_line1, CAST(location.city_name AS STRING) AS city_name, CAST(location.state_code AS STRING) AS state_code, CAST(location.zip AS STRING) AS zip, 'session.pp_usa_r_khk6e1jw9c15' AS via FROM session.pp_usa_r_khk6e1jw9c15 WHERE CAST(location.state_code AS STRING) = 'NJ' AND upper(CAST(location.city_name AS STRING)) = 'TINTON FALLS' AND CAST(location.address_line1 AS STRING) LIKE '1 %' LIMIT 50

SELECT request_id, new_routing, CASE WHEN COALESCE((new_routing IS NULL OR (new_routing RLIKE '^[0-9]{9}$' AND pmod(3 * ((ascii(substr(new_routing, 1, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 4, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 7, 1)) - 48)) + 7 * ((ascii(substr(new_routing, 2, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 5, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 8, 1)) - 48)) + ((ascii(substr(new_routing, 3, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 6, 1)) - 48) + (ascii(substr(new_routing, 9, 1)) - 48)), 10) = 0)), false) THEN 'valid' ELSE 'invalid' END AS routing_check FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.bank_change_request WHERE request_id = 'BCR-2026-0412' LIMIT 1
RUN DQ unverified_recent_bank_change TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item
RUN DQ account_single_vendor TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item
SHOW DQ INVALID RECORD unverified_recent_bank_change TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item
SHOW DQ INVALID RECORD account_single_vendor TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_rows FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_hash FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account GROUP BY account_hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) > 1) s ON s.account_hash = b.account_hash LIMIT 1

SELECT account_hash, COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) AS vendor_count, concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(vendor_id))) AS vendor_ids, concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(CAST(status AS STRING)))) AS statuses FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account GROUP BY account_hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) > 1 LIMIT 50
RUN DQ bank_change_before_large_payment TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item
SHOW DQ INVALID RECORD bank_change_before_large_payment TABLE lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item p JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id LIMIT 1

SELECT p.item_id, p.vendor_id, p.vendor_name, v.legal_name, v.name_norm AS legal_name_norm, trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) AS payee_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item p JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id WHERE NOT (trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm) LIMIT 500

SELECT CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) AS vendor_id, CAST(v.legal_name AS STRING) AS vendor_name, CAST(v.uei AS STRING) AS uei, e.legal_name AS usa_legal_name, e.address_line1 AS usa_address_line1, e.city_name AS usa_city, e.state_code AS usa_state, e.zip AS usa_zip, s.cik AS cik, s.legal_name AS edgar_legal_name, s.phone AS edgar_phone, s.ein AS edgar_ein, p.payment_item_count, p.total_exposure FROM payee_erp.vendor v LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(vendor_id AS STRING) AS vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_item_count, SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_exposure FROM payee_erp.payment_run_item GROUP BY CAST(vendor_id AS STRING)) p ON p.vendor_id = CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity e ON e.uei = CAST(v.uei AS STRING) LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant s ON s.cik = CAST(v.registrant_cik AS STRING) WHERE CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) = 'V-10027' LIMIT 10
